notes: Downstage 1.1: a pedalboard with 33 classic stompboxes; a mastering section (Abbey Road TG chain, Shadow Hills, Massive Passive, Maag); Lexicon 480L with its LARC, Quadraverb and Abbey Road Chambers; Kemper, a tuner and a note-tuned EQ; EMI, Siemens, Midas, API and Golden Age units; 600+ presets; tempo detection and quantize; the waveform while recording; pages on extra displays; session templates; new meters.
